recall_prompt: Say how you would do this one — name the formula you use and how you finish.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: State the tangent formula
steps.margin_note: First mark. Tangent repeats twice as often as sine and cosine, so its formula has π on top, not 2π. Writing the right one is the mark.

recall.must_convey: That the period of tan kx is π/|k| — π, not 2π.
accept: the period of tan k x is pi over mod k not two pi
tangent has period pi over k
write the tan formula, pi by mod k
tan ki period pi by mod k

steps.why: tan repeats every π because tan(θ + π) = tan θ. Using the cosine formula here doubles the answer.

steps.label: Substitute k = 5

recall.must_convey: That k = 5, so the period is π/5.
accept: k is five so the period is pi over five
the answer is pi by five
substituting gives pi divided by five
k five kabatti pi by five
the period is pi over five

steps.why: A larger coefficient compresses the graph, so the period shrinks — π/5 is much shorter than π, as expected.
